label: fight_library
_why: 3.4 Restrained on an ally: a guard caught in a net (set directly, standing in for the Net ability still to come) never moves. In round 1 the archer shares its tile, so it fights from the spot at disadvantage (Restrained) and the archer's shot at it has advantage (Restrained). Once the archer falls back out of reach, the guard spends its turn on a Strength check against DC 10 and breaks free. Seeded, with refresh.
